## 2. Core Technical Stack

1. **TypeScript:** Strict static typing across React components, form workflows, multi-tenant API contracts, and full-stack modules.
2. **React (React 19):** Accessible, modular UI engineering, granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) interfaces, virtualization, and optimistic state patterns.
3. **Next.js (App Router, Server Components):** Server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), multi-layer request caching, localized routing (`/en`, `/ru`, `/uz`), structured data (JSON-LD), and Core Web Vitals optimization.
4. **Tailwind CSS:** Architectural dark/light UI systems, responsive enterprise dashboards, and clean design tokens without runtime bloat.
5. **TanStack Query (React Query):** Multi-layer API caching, request deduplication, incremental on-scroll pagination, and predictable state synchronization.
6. **WebSockets:** Real-time operational status updates, live workflow tracking, and responsive client synchronization.
7. **Python (Telegram Bots & Backend integration):** Custom Telegram Bots, Telegram WebApps, automated business accounting flows, and external API/AI pipeline integrations.

## 4. Detailed Production Case Studies

### 4.1 Igoo — Multi-Tenant CRM & ERP for Learning Centers
- **Live URL:** https://igoo.uz
- **Year:** 2026
- **Role:** Frontend Engineer (Built at Infonex)
- **Category:** Education & CRM / Multi-Tenant SaaS
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Cross-Subdomain Auth, Tailwind CSS
- **Problem:** In multi-tenant SaaS platforms, registering on the main domain (`igoo.uz`) and redirecting to a newly provisioned tenant subdomain often forces users to log in a second time, introducing onboarding friction alongside complex API state management.
- **Solution:** Engineered a seamless cross-subdomain authentication token handoff from `igoo.uz` directly to the tenant's dedicated subdomain upon sign-up—eliminating repeat logins—and built the frontend UI modules and client API integration layers.
- **Key Highlights:**
  - Cross-subdomain token transfer from `igoo.uz` to isolated school subdomains (zero re-login onboarding).
  - End-to-end client API integration, state synchronization, and error handling across CRM/ERP workflows.
  - Interactive UI modules for student admissions, group management, class schedules, attendance, and financial dashboards.

### 4.2 HomeX Admin — Operations Dashboard with Checkbox-Based RBAC
- **Year:** 2026
- **Role:** Frontend Engineer (Built at Infonex)
- **Category:** Operations & Productivity / Admin Dashboard
- **Tech Stack:** React 19, TypeScript, Role-Based Access (RBAC), Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Dynamic Routing
- **Problem:** As operations teams grow, granting every staff member access to the entire admin panel exposes sensitive business data and clutters daily workflows.
- **Solution:** Built the frontend UI modules and implemented a dynamic checkbox-based permission system where administrators select exact authorized pages when creating or editing staff accounts, coupled with strict route and navigation guards.
- **Key Highlights:**
  - Checkbox-driven page-level RBAC configuration during staff onboarding.
  - 100% guarded routes and navigation menus dynamically scoped to each employee's permissions.
  - Modular admin UI components, operational data tables, and service tracking views.

### 4.3 Tashkent Logistics — Custom Telegram Bot & Accounting Automation
- **Year:** 2026
- **Role:** Product & Full-Stack Engineer (Custom Client Project)
- **Category:** Fleet & Operations / B2B Automation
- **Tech Stack:** Telegram Bot API, TypeScript, Node.js / Fastify, PostgreSQL, Automated Accounting, Next.js
- **Problem:** Logistics operations lost time and accuracy to manual financial calculations, scattered order tracking, and operational friction that required understanding real on-the-ground workflows.
- **Solution:** Spent two full days embedded on-site with the client's team in Tashkent to map exact accounting formulas and workflow bottlenecks, then delivered a tailored Telegram bot automating daily order logging, driver balances, and financial tracking.
- **Key Highlights:**
  - 2-day on-site operational discovery inside the client's daily business operations.
  - Custom Telegram bot tailored to the team's daily habits for zero-friction order and expense tracking.
  - Adopted across the client team with full workflow coverage.

### 4.4 HalalHub — High-Speed Halal Food Discovery Platform
- **Live URL:** https://wehalalhub.com
- **Year:** 2026
- **Role:** Frontend Engineer (Built at Infonex)
- **Category:** Food Delivery & Discovery
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, React Query (TanStack Query), TypeScript, Google & Apple Auth, Infinite Scroll, Tailwind CSS
- **Problem:** Redundant API calls, loading full restaurant catalogs at once, and heavy video feeds caused slow initial page loads, unnecessary server load, and laggy scrolling in Reels discovery.
- **Solution:** Implemented multi-layer caching with React Query and Next.js, engineered lag-free Reels playback and scroll buffering, integrated Google and Apple OAuth sign-in, and built viewport-driven incremental infinite scroll.
- **Key Highlights:**
  - Multi-layer React Query + Next.js caching preventing redundant API requests and cutting initial wait times.
  - Zero-lag video Reels playback and smart scroll buffering.
  - Incremental viewport-first restaurant pagination and Google & Apple OAuth authentication.

### 4.5 AuraNews — Open-Source AI News Aggregation Platform
- **Repository:** https://github.com/omonboyweb/news-startup
- **Year:** 2026
- **Role:** Creator & Full-Stack Engineer (Open Source Project)
- **Category:** Media & Productivity / AI Automation
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 15, TypeScript, DeepSeek API, Google AI Studio (Gemini), PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS
- **Problem:** Manually tracking dozens of web sources and summarizing breaking news into clean, structured stories requires hours of repetitive editorial work.
- **Solution:** Architected an automated news aggregation pipeline using DeepSeek APIs and Google AI Studio (Gemini) to gather, deduplicate, and structure breaking stories into clean Uzbek articles with 3-point summaries and instant Latin/Cyrillic script switching on Next.js 15.

## 5. Engineering Blog Articles (Published on omon.dev)

1. **How Apps Like Instagram Scale to Millions Without Slowing Down** (`https://omon.dev/en/blog/how-big-apps-add-servers-without-breaking`, Nov 12, 2026, System Design)
   - Key Takeaway: Consistent hashing prevents cache reshuffling storms when scaling servers, keeping latency steady under growth.
2. **Why Scrolling 50,000 Items Feels Instant on Your Phone** (`https://omon.dev/en/blog/why-scrolling-50000-items-feels-instant`, Nov 04, 2026, Web Speed)
   - Key Takeaway: Meeting the 16ms 60fps frame budget by virtualizing and rendering only the visible viewport window plus a small buffer.
3. **Designing Apps That Never Lose Your Work When Wi-Fi Drops** (`https://omon.dev/en/blog/building-apps-that-never-lose-work-offline`, Oct 21, 2026, Product Craft)
   - Key Takeaway: Local-first writes saved on-device in milliseconds combined with background sync and timestamped conflict resolution.
4. **The Simple Mental Trick Behind Instant Search & Smart Filtering** (`https://omon.dev/en/blog/how-instant-search-avoids-repeating-work`, Oct 08, 2026, Problem Solving)
   - Key Takeaway: Single-pass sliding window / pointer state tracking avoids redundant work in instant search bars and duplicate payment checks.
